0.desc: This exceptional LOCALS ONLY creation delivers an unparalleled combination of potency and flavor, meticulously crafted to satisfy even the most discerning cannabis connoisseurs. The live wet diamonds extraction process preserves the plant's natural terpene profile, resulting in a concentrate that captures the essence of fresh, ripe figs with remarkable clarity. Each 1-gram jar contains high-purity THCA crystals suspended in a rich, flavorful terpene sauce, offering a perfect balance of potency and taste. 1.desc: Diamond Bar Wet Badder is a sharp, sativa-leaning hybrid concentrate that brings electric flavor and record-breaking potency. Bred by crossing Diamond Dust with a select Fig Bar Male (GSE 55), this in-house creation sets a new bar—literally. The first lab test shattered expectations, clocking in at an impressive 4.4% total terpenes, delivering a powerhouse sensory experience. Packed into a 1g jar of rich, velvety badder, Diamond Bar hits with a refreshing burst of Lime Gatorade-like citrus, followed by a bright, energetic lift that’s perfect for daytime sessions. This concentrate is for those who want bold flavor, top-tier terpene content, and a buzz that cuts through the noise.

2.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Max AC's dynamic progression from an energizing lift to a serene, grounding calm invites you to embrace an active, yet reflective state, transforming your day into an exploration of both creative vibrancy and peaceful repose.Strain Type: Hybrid Lineage: [Mac 1] x [Animal Cookies] Breeder: Greenpoint Genetics Primary Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Bisabolol Top Reported Strain Effects: Calm, Contented, Motivated, Uplifted, Peaceful Top Reported Strain Flavors: Citrus, Creamy, Spicy, Earthy, Herbal, Floral The Product: Uncured fresh frozen plant material created into a frosting/peanut-butter like substance that is high in terpene content allowing maximum flavor and effect. This consistency is easy to handle and on par with live budder for potency.

3.desc:
Kandy Cake is a cured resin badder crafted from Bass River Buds’ organically grown, no-till living soil flower, bringing together the rich genetic pairing of Kut Throat Kandy x Ice Cream Cake in a terpene-forward concentrate format. Carefully dried, cured, and extracted to preserve the cultivar’s natural complexity, this batch delivers a dense, creamy profile layered with candy sweetness, vanilla frosting, earthy gas, and subtle citrus brightness. Floral undertones and soft spice from its dominant terpene blend round out the finish with classic cured resin depth and full-bodied character.

Led by high levels of ß-Caryophyllene alongside Limonene, ß-Myrcene, and Linalool, Kandy Cake offers a balanced aromatic profile that moves between sweet dessert richness and savory fuel notes without losing the cultivar’s natural expression. The badder consistency provides a smooth, workable texture ideal for flavorful concentrate sessions while staying true to the source flower.

Produced as part of the Eclipse x Bass River Buds collaboration, this cured resin badder is made from 100% cannabis with nothing added — preserving the integrity of the flower, the extraction, and the cultivar-driven terpene profile from start to finish.

4.desc:
Triple Gas is a cured resin badder crafted from Bass River Buds’ organically grown, no-till living soil flower. A bold blend of Donny Burger, Animal Face, and Platinum Dolato, this concentrate preserves the cultivar’s naturally heavy, savory, and fuel-forward profile through a careful cured resin extraction process.

The flavor opens with pungent diesel, earthy funk, and peppery spice before rounding into bright citrus, subtle floral notes, and a smooth doughy sweetness on the finish. Driven by dominant levels of ß-Caryophyllene, Limonene, and a-Humulene, Triple Gas delivers layered gassy depth with rich cured resin character and a balanced terpene-forward profile.

Carefully dried, cured, and extracted to retain the integrity of the source flower, this badder features a soft, workable consistency ideal for consumers seeking a flavorful and strain-specific dabbable concentrate experience.

Made with 100% cannabis and nothing added, Eclipse x Bass River Buds Triple Gas Cured Resin Badder reflects clean extraction, quality cultivation, and concentrate craftsmanship rooted in the natural expression of the flower.

The smooth badder consistency preserves the cultivar’s rich cannabis character and terpene profile, offering a workable texture designed for flavorful concentrate sessions. Eclipse X Megaleaf showcases this strain with a true-to-plant cured resin extraction made from 100% cannabis with nothing added.

Crafted with a focus on terpene preservation, flavor expression, and extraction quality, this MegaBoof badder delivers a rich, strain-forward profile with layered cannabis flavor from start to finish.

14.desc: The oldest hash on earth and still the hardest to make: live resin rubbed by hand off the flowering plant and rolled until it darkens into a soft, glossy ball. Cold Cure Live Rosin
For our Cold Cure, we collect the rosin from the press and put it all together in one big jar. We then allow the natural process of separation and buddering to occur before we finally whip the rosin together and put it back into cold storage. The consistency of the Cold Cure is a smooth, slightly wet batter.

Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.  Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers. 

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

Lineage: [Afghani] x [OG Kush]

Breeder: Apothecary Genetics

Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.  Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers. 

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

169.desc:
The Black Maple strain is a unique hybrid strain that combines the genetic traits of the Dulce De Uva and Sherbanger strains. As a hybrid variety, it has inherited qualities from both its parent strains, resulting in a unique genetic makeup that gives it distinct features, effects, and characteristics.

Dulce De Uva, a cross of Grape Pie and OG Kush, is cherished for its sweet, grape-like scent and deeply relaxing stone. Sherbanger, the other parent of Black Maple, is known for its rich, creamy flavor and dense, frosty buds. By combining the two, Bloom Seeds has created a stellar hybrid that embodies all the qualities of an elite strain.

The flavor of this strain is just as delightful, coating the mouth with the sweet flavors of blueberry ice cream and exotic spices. The taste lingers for several minutes, making for a pleasant experience that any cannabis user is sure to love.

170.desc:
Animal Star Cookies is a balanced hybrid strain expertly crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the union of Animal Cookies and Stardawg. This unique blend combines the soothing qualities of an indica with the uplifting effects of a sativa, offering a gentle yet powerful experience that calms the body and elevates the spirit. With its harmonious nature, Animal Star Cookies helps users relax and find themselves in a state of emotional well-being.
The strain's rich terpene profile contributes to its complex flavors and effects. Sweet and earthy notes are complemented by hints of vanilla and nutty undertones, creating a delightful and nuanced taste experience. The presence of Limonene adds a subtle citrus zest, while Linalool imparts gentle floral accents. These terpenes enhance not only the flavor but also promote a calming and uplifting mood.
Drawing from its parent genetics, Animal Star Cookies inherits the full-body relaxation characteristic of Animal Cookies and the mood-enhancing properties of Stardawg. Users often report feelings of tranquility and happiness, with a gentle elevation of mood that eases away stress and encourages a positive mindset. This balanced hybrid is ideal for those seeking to unwind while maintaining a sense of alertness and emotional well-being.

Cerebral. Invigorating. Euphoric. All words that describe (Headband x ChemD) x Skunkdog Bx1. This standout from Matchmaker Genetics brings together two legendary cultivars of prohibition-era cannabis with a proven male stud used in over thirty outcrosses by the breeder.

Our selected phenotype grows with moderate vigor and a healthy spread of branches that bloom conical, Christmas tree-shaped flowers. Expect a slightly sour, diesel fuel-tinged aroma up front from the Headband lineage, followed by a heavy-hitting chemical cleaner and fuel finish – classic ChemD.

The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. This powerhouse male amplifies the acrid funk of Headband and ChemD and adds hardiness to the cross. While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait – a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

195.desc:

This strain is part of Breakwater's Pheno Hunt project. Short for “Phenotype Hunt,” a Pheno Hunt is the search for the best possible version of a strain. When we acquire seeds of a compelling strain, we grow multiple plants to maturity. Each plant is a unique physical expression or phenotype of its genetic makeup (just like children from the same parents can be quite different). We evaluate each phenotype for traits such as flower size, plant structure, aromas, effects, and potency. In a successful Pheno Hunt, the most promising candidate will become a mother plant for a new strain of Breakwater Premium Flower.

With this new patient-facing project, we're inviting you to participate in this process and give us your feedback on which pheno is the best fit for our patients!

201.desc: Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher ------------- Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu. ------------- Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different. Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole. Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

209.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

210.desc:
Banana Split is a hybrid cultivar known for its sweet dessert-like aroma, colorful appearance, and heavy resin production. The flowers are typically dense and well-structured, featuring bright green buds with occasional purple accents, vivid orange pistils, and a thick coating of frosty, sparkling trichomes that give the flower a sugary, premium finish.

Aroma & Flavor
Banana Split is commonly described as offering a rich blend of ripe banana and creamy sweetness layered with tropical fruit and subtle citrus brightness. Light notes of vanilla, sweet candy, and a faint earthy undertone add depth and balance. The flavor follows through with a smooth combination of sweet banana, creamy dessert notes, and a lightly fruity, soft earthy finish on the exhale.

Experience

215.desc:
Yoshi from Pete’s Farmstand is best thought of as a bright, modern hybrid with a playful profile. Based on how Pete’s Farmstand menus and related strain descriptions are typically presented, it likely leans toward sweet, fruity, and candy-like notes rather than the heavy gas of a classic OG, with a flavor that feels more lively than earthy.

The experience is usually described as balanced at first, with a quick cerebral lift that can make things feel more upbeat, chatty, and visually sharp before easing into a gentler body calm. That makes it a strain many people associate with afternoon or early evening use, especially when they want something enjoyable without immediately getting knocked out.

If you like strains that feel modern, flavorful, and easy to enjoy, Yoshi fits that lane well. It sounds like one of Pete’s Farmstand’s more approachable options: less pine-and-diesel, more sweet smoke, smooth vibes, and a steady hybrid finish.

216.desc:

Breeder: Seed Junky Genetics

Taste Notes: Sweet berries, citrus zest, with a creamy earthy diesel undertone.

Super Runtz is a hybrid from Seed Junky Genetics that brings LCG and Runtz genetics together. Sweet berries and citrus zest open the profile before settling into creamy earthy diesel undertones. With a terpene profile that balances fruit-forward brightness with fuel complexity, this cultivar demonstrates sophisticated aromatic layering.

The LCG lineage contributes creamy diesel foundation and structural depth, while Runtz introduces its signature berry sweetness and citrus brightness. Effects tend to begin with gentle mental ease before transitioning into substantial body relaxation, creating an experience that maintains clarity while delivering indica weight.

This cultivar speaks to those seeking refined candy genetics with genuine complexity—sweet fruit expression grounded by traditional diesel character for evening use that satisfies both flavor and effect expectations.

217.desc:
This drop is bigger than just flower. It’s about legacy, culture, and respect.

White Boy Kev is a Washington Heights legend. Back in the early 90’s, when the city was in the grip of the crack epidemic, Kev chose a different lane. He carved out his own path with weed because he never saw it as a drug – to him it was medicine, community, and love for the block. It was a way to uplift, not harm. Running three spots in the Heights, Kev built his name the real way: he gave the community something authentic, something that healed.

Fast-forward 35 years, and Kev's still in it for the plant – not just as a hustler, but as a grower. His pursuit now is mastery: learning, evolving, and working with cultivators who share his dedication to quality. That's why teaming up with niche. made sense – Jersey and Washington Heights are just a river apart, and this collaboration bridges that gap.

Irish Springz celebrates a genuine legend in the game. This is legacy work – paying homage to the ones who paved the way while pushing the culture forward.

----

Irish Springz is a hybrid that delivers a clean, nostalgic flavor experience—sweet notes that flow into delicate floral characteristics before finishing with that distinctive soapy dryer sheet aroma that gives this strain its name.

Effects might offer that balanced flow between mental clarity and physical relaxation. Many people appreciate how this one can work for different parts of the day, though everyone's experience varies. With 34.53% Total THC and a terpene profile led by ß-Caryophyllene and d-Limonene, this strain brings both potency and complexity to the table.

This hybrid connects with those who want flavors that tell a story and effects that keep things real. It's got that old-school authenticity with modern craft appeal—a strain that represents legacy, culture, and the bridge between street wisdom and cultivation mastery for those looking to experience something with genuine roots.

As the high deepens, users begin to experience profound physical relaxation, which is reflective of the strain’s indica heritage. Medical users have noted that this shift can be particularly beneficial for relieving muscle tension, chronic pain, and stress-related symptoms.

246.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. The 3.5g size provides excellent value for both newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts looking to explore GREEN LIGHTNING's premium quality. Experience the winning combination of flavor, effects, and craftsmanship with Don Shula.

266.desc:
Brute's Roots "Blue Lobzter" 3.5g is a premium, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower cultivated and distributed across recreational dispensaries in New Jersey. This award-winning strain is a rare cross between Apples N Bananas and Eye Candy, originally popularized by Maine Trees and bred by Chris Lynch.

Strain Profile & Characteristics

• Lineage: Apples N Bananas x Eye Candy
• Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
• Potency & Terpenes: Batches from Brute's Roots typically test quite high, showing around 32.9% THC and 2.14% Terpenes.
• Appearance: Dense, resinous emerald buds featuring deep blue and purple undertones, heavily frosted in trichomes and accented by fiery orange hairs—resembling a unique "lobster shell" aesthetic.
• Aroma & Flavor: A complex "fruity gas" profile. It leads with a sweet, sugary blueberry candy and grape flavor, followed by hints of tart green apples, creamy undertones, and a smooth citrus/gassy finish.

Effects & Experience

The strain hits quickly, delivering a soaring, euphoric mental high that boosts mood and creativity. This is followed closely by a deep, calming physical relaxation that settles across the body, easing tension without immediately locking you to the couch. It is highly regarded as a great late-afternoon or evening strain for unwinding or socializing.

267.desc: Purple Pressure by Hugh Douglas is a highly potent hybrid strain that delivers a loud aroma of sweet citrus, cinnamon-coated orange, pungent diesel, and woody pine. On the palate, it offers a smooth, doughy flavor marked by sour citrus and a spicy pepper-vanilla exhale. The effects hit quickly, starting with an uplifting, euphoric cerebral buzz that promotes happiness and chattiness before transitioning into a deeply relaxing body wave that melts away physical tension, making it a popular choice for relieving chronic stress, anxiety, and inflammation.

268.desc: The Happy Farmer "Grand Scarlet Jelly" (3.5g) is a premium hybrid cannabis strain known for its sweet, fruit-forward profile that smells intensely of ripe berries, sugary fruit preserves, and doughy, cream-like undertones. Driven by dominant terpenes like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene, it delivers a balanced, multi-stage experience that begins with a bright, euphoric cerebral lift to dissolve mental stress. This initial high smoothly transitions into a deeply soothing body relaxation that melts muscular tension away without causing heavy, immediate sedation, making it an excellent choice for late afternoon decompression, creative unwinding, or social evenings.

269.desc:
Blueprint’s Chef is a flavorful hybrid flower in a premium 3.5g format, built from Zoap BX1 genetics and known for its euphoric, social character.

Expect a lively mix of sweet candy, funky gas, and bright floral notes, accented by hints of lavender. The terpene profile balances sugary sweetness with savory funk and a soft floral finish for a layered, aromatic smoke.

Chef brings an upbeat, euphoric experience with a social-friendly vibe, making it a great choice for sharing with friends, creative moments, or simply enjoying a flavorful hybrid session.

270.desc: Blockberry is an evenly balanced hybrid strain created by crossing Black Cherry Punch and Tropicanna Cookies F2. Best known for its highly sought-after phenotype Superboof, it features a complex flavor profile of sharp tropical berries, zesty citrus candy, and smooth vanilla funk. It delivers a versatile experience that begins with a bright, creative cerebral uplift before transitioning into a deeply relaxing body high that avoids heavy couch-lock. For cultivators, the strain is highly prized for its vibrant purple and autumn coloration, massive yields, and exceptional suitability for hash production.

271.desc: "Pink Ink" by The Cut is a premium, trichome-heavy hybrid cannabis strain bred from a cross of Permanent Marker and Spritzer. Cultivated and distributed primarily in the New Jersey market, it typically boasts a potent profile dominated by the terpenes limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool. This composition delivers a unique sensory contrast, blending the sweet, chalky flavor of pink hard candies and berries with a pungent, gassy diesel undertone. Users generally experience an initial upbeat, creative head buzz that smoothly transitions into a deeply relaxing, euphoric body high.

272.desc: Grown Rogue Lantz (3.5g) delivers a complex aromatic profile defined by a sharp contrast of sweet tart candy and rich citrus layered over a heavy, pungent diesel and pine gas undertone. The experience begins with an immediate uplifting cerebral buzz that sharpens focus and sparks creativity, making it a great choice for social settings or creative projects. Over time, this energetic onset smoothly transitions into a deeply grounding physical relaxation that relieves muscle tension without causing overwhelming sedation. Because of this balanced, dual-stage effect, consumers frequently look to this strain for late-afternoon or evening use to help manage stress, anxiety, and insomnia.

273.desc:
Star Killer is a potent indica-dominant strain prized for its deeply relaxing effects, pungent aroma, and rich, earthy flavor profile. A cross of Skywalker OG and Rare Dankness #2, Star Killer delivers dense, resin-coated buds with vibrant green hues, fiery orange pistils, and a frosty blanket of trichomes. It's an excellent choice for evening sessions when you're ready to unwind and leave the day's stress behind.

The experience begins with a gentle cerebral calm that eases racing thoughts before transitioning into a heavy, soothing body relaxation. As the effects build, users often report a tranquil, sedating finish that makes Star Killer ideal for quiet nights, movie marathons, or preparing for restful sleep.

Flavor Profile:
Earthy pine, Diesel fuel, Herbal spice, Hints of citrus, Woody finish

Dominant Terpenes:
Myrcene – Earthy and herbal, known for its deeply relaxing and body-soothing effects.
Caryophyllene – Peppery spice that may help promote stress relief and physical comfort.
Limonene – Adds a subtle citrus brightness and may elevate mood while balancing the heavier effects.
Humulene (Minor) – Woody and herbal, contributing depth to the aroma and flavor.

Effects:
Deep body relaxation
Calm and euphoric
Stress relief
Sleepy and sedating
Ideal for nighttime use

Ideal For:
Evening and nighttime sessions
Relaxing after a long day
Watching movies or gaming
Quiet nights at home
Unwinding before bed

276.desc: Kush Mints is a hybrid weed strain made from a genetic cross between Animal Mints and Bubba Kush. This strain is 50% sativa and 50% indica. Kush Mints is a potent and flavorful strain that has a minty and cookie-like aroma and flavor, with hints of gas and pine. It has a balanced high that is both relaxing and euphoric, with a pleasant body buzz and a creative mind. Kush Mints effects include feeling relaxed, euphoric, and aroused. Medical marijuana patients often choose Kush Mints when dealing with symptoms associated with anxiety, stress, and depression. Kush Mints features flavors like mint, menthol, and pine. The dominant terpene of this strain is limonene.

277.desc: Blood Orange Gas cannabis delivers a vibrant flavor profile dominated by a sweet, tangy blast of freshly sliced citrus and tart blood orange rind, beautifully balanced by a sharp, skunky undertone and a faint trace of diesel gas upon exhalation. Its aroma mirrors this complexity, filling the room with an invigorating fusion of loud, zesty orange peel and underlying musky, earthy notes. Upon consumption, it hits quickly with a burst of uplifting, cerebral energy that boosts focus, sparks creativity, and induces a talkative, happy state of mind—making it a perfect companion for productive daytime activities or lively social settings without heavy physical sedation.

278.desc: Fresh Reserve GMO 3.5g is a potent, premium cannabis flower grown by FRESH. A cross between Chemdog and Girl Scout Cookies, this strain delivers a famously pungent, savory aroma of garlic, skunk, mushroom, and earthy diesel. Known for its heavy, couch-locking physical relaxation, it is ideal for evening use, relieving stress, and easing deep tension.

279.desc: CRAFT KINGS presents Cali Cake, a premium hybrid flower delivering the perfect balance of relaxation and uplift. This 7g pre-pack showcases dense, resinous buds with a captivating aroma profile blending sweet vanilla and creamy cake batter notes with earthy undertones. Cali Cake's hybrid nature offers versatile effects that inspire creativity and euphoria while maintaining a soothing body calm, making it ideal for both daytime focus and evening unwind sessions. The rich, dessert-like flavor profile delivers smooth, indulgent smoke with hints of spice and subtle citrus on the exhale. Perfect for cannabis enthusiasts seeking craft-quality flower with sophisticated terpene expression and well-rounded effects. Whether you're looking to enhance social experiences or simply enjoy a flavorful, relaxing session, this 7 gram offering provides exceptional value and quality from a trusted craft cannabis brand.

280.desc:
A hybrid indica that’s as rich in flavor as it is in prestige. With a powerful lineage that blends Billy Kimber OG, Zangria, and Girl Scout Cookies, this strain is a VIP experience for your taste buds. Expect a complex flavor profile that combines earthy OG notes, zesty fruitiness, and that signature sweetness from GSC. The high? A smooth, full-body relaxation that feels like you’re living the high life. Prezidential – for when you want to treat yourself like royalty with a flavor-packed experience!

At "Made," we embrace the essence of cannabis in its purest form. Our journey began with a simple belief: that the true essence of cannabis lies not just in its consumption but in the connections it fosters, the memories it weaves, and the sense of community it creates. Drawing inspiration from the rich history of this ancient plant, "Made" emerges as a brand that cherishes and preserves the legacy of cannabis, crafting products that speak to the heart of true connoisseurs.

281.desc:
The sweet escape you’ve been waiting for! This hybrid strain brings together a sugary-sweet flavor profile that’ll have you feeling like you’ve just walked into a candy shop. With hints of sugary goodness, vanilla, and a touch of earthiness, Sugar Shack offers a smooth, relaxing high that melts away stress while keeping you calm and happy. Perfect for kicking back and letting your worries dissolve like sugar in the sun. Sugar Shack – for when you want to treat yourself to a little sweetness.

282.desc: Giraffe Puzzy is a vibrant hybrid that brings tropical fruit character together with a rich, bakery-inspired finish. Bursts of sweet citrus and candy-like fruit create an expressive opening, while subtle notes of earth and warm dough add depth beneath the sweetness. Its layered personality reflects the meeting of Z and Animal Cookies Bx2, delivering a profile that feels playful up front with a more grounded character underneath. Distinctive, flavorful, and full of contrast, Giraffe Puzzy brings a fresh identity to the hybrid lineup.

283.desc:
Dive into bold, savory flavor with Governmint Oasis Flower from Delight. This 3.5g offering brings a complex aroma to the table, blending pungent garlic funk inspired by its GMO parent with icy mint, gassy diesel, and earthy spice. On the inhale, expect garlicky sweetness layered with fresh herbal mint, followed by a creamy, fuel-forward finish that keeps each puff intriguing.

Its reported experience begins with a tingly body buzz and a gentle mood lift before settling into deeper body relaxation and a calm, mellow headspace. For fans of funky, minty flower with plenty of character, Governmint Oasis is worth exploring.

289.desc:
Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Born from the legendary union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush, this strain captures the best qualities of its renowned parentage. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

Strain Type: Hybrid
Lineage: [Blueberry] x [Bubba Kush]
Breeder: Royal King Seeds
Primary Terpene Profile: Myrcene, Pinene, Caryophyllene
Top Reported Strain Effects: Happy, Creative, Hungry, Sleepy, Euphoric
Top Reported Strain Flavors: Berry, Blueberry, Cheesy, Sweet, Earthy

290.desc: Haze x Mudd Brothers Sour Brunch x Harlem Nights Live Rosin Infused Pre-Roll 1g is a hybrid infused pre-roll typically priced around $30.00. It blends Sour Brunch and Harlem Nights flower infused with live rosin, offering balanced calm, happy, and relaxed effects.

291.desc: The Haze 1g pre-roll featuring a cross of Jet Fuel x Temptation F3 combines a high-energy, diesel-forward sativa hybrid with a gassy, citrus-and-cake-leaning hybrid. This potent cross leans heavily into pungent fuel aromas, delivering an uplifting cerebral rush alongside a mellow, relaxed body feel.

Jersey Runtz from Garden Greens is a sweet, candy-like hybrid with the kind of bold flavor profile that has made Runtz family strains so popular. It usually brings fruity, tropical notes up front, followed by creamy undertones and a light earthy or gassy finish that adds depth to the experience.

The flower is typically dense, frosty, and visually striking, with bright green buds, purple accents, and vivid orange hairs. That polished look gives it strong bag appeal and makes it feel like a premium craft selection.

In terms of effects, Jersey Runtz is often described as balanced and enjoyable, starting with an upbeat, happy headspace before easing into a calm, relaxed body feel. It can be a good choice for people who want something flavorful and smooth without feeling overly heavy too soon.

Overall, Garden Greens’ Jersey Runtz delivers a well-rounded mix of sweetness, aroma, and relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that appeals to consumers who like dessert-style cannabis with a lively, approachable finish.

294.desc: PAR "Hash Infused Irons" in the Garden State Green strain is a highly potent hybrid multi-pack featuring five 0.7g flower pre-rolls infused with 0.3g of concentrated hash each. Because it heavily concentrates the hybrid flower with traditional hash, users can expect immediate, hard-hitting effects that balance an initial euphoric cerebral buzz with a deeply relaxing, heavy full-body calm.

299.desc:
The Gorilla Pie strain is a hybrid cannabis strain (50% Indica and 50% Sativa) combining Gorilla Glue # 4 and Jelly Pie. Due to its potency, this cannabis strain has grown in popularity due to euphoric, creative, and giggly side effects. The Gorilla Pie strain has an aroma containing earthy notes with tea and grapefruit. Gorilla Pie’s dominant terpene is pinene, ensuring a fresh smell that delights the senses.

This cannabis strain has a sweet flavor with berries, spicy herbs, and peppery diesel undertones. For people with chronic pain, the Gorilla Pie strain is favored for its medicinal benefits—such as pain relief and anxiety reduction. Keep in mind that this strain is a better choice for experienced cannabis smokers rather than beginners because of its powerful effects.

300.desc: The Funk is back! Dr. Funkenstein, also known as “Dr. Funk”, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain born from the union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush. This funky bud embodies the best qualities of its celebrity parentage, delivering an enticing combination of palate-pleasing flavors and potent effects. As you partake in Dr. Funkenstein, the flavor profile reflects its genetic heritage, providing a delightful combination of sweet berry and earthy sharpness that activates on the exhale.

301.desc:
The Black Maple strain is a unique hybrid strain that combines the genetic traits of the Dulce De Uva and Sherbanger strains. As a hybrid variety, it has inherited qualities from both its parent strains, resulting in a unique genetic makeup that gives it distinct features, effects, and characteristics.

Dulce De Uva, a cross of Grape Pie and OG Kush, is cherished for its sweet, grape-like scent and deeply relaxing stone. Sherbanger, the other parent of Black Maple, is known for its rich, creamy flavor and dense, frosty buds. By combining the two, Bloom Seeds has created a stellar hybrid that embodies all the qualities of an elite strain.

The flavor of this strain is just as delightful, coating the mouth with the sweet flavors of blueberry ice cream and exotic spices. The taste lingers for several minutes, making for a pleasant experience that any cannabis user is sure to love.

302.desc:
Dr. Funkenstein, also known as “Dr. Funk”, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain born from the union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush. This funky bud embodies the best qualities of its celebrity parentage, delivering an enticing combination of palate-pleasing flavors and potent effects. As you partake in Dr. Funkenstein, the flavor profile reflects its genetic heritage, providing a delightful combination of
sweet berry and earthy sharpness that activates on the exhale. The strain’s appearance features tight, compact popcorn-shaped dark forest green nugs adorned with thick, furry orange hairs, and each nug is generously coated with
a frosty layer of white crystal trichomes and sticky resin. The strain's dense buds and prominent trichome coverage not only contribute to its visual appeal but also underscore its potential strength.

303.desc:
Gyat delivers a tropical fusion of sweet pineapple and rich blueberry, complemented by earthy undertones. This strain offers a vibrant and fruity aroma, making each inhale a delightful experience. Users can expect a balanced high that promotes creativity and energy, coupled with a happy and uplifting mood. Gyat is designed to enhance daytime activities, making it ideal for social gatherings or creative endeavors.

Crisp, clean and beautiful. This SSH cross has all the fruity funk you need. Indica leaning and relaxing but keeps the mind sharp.

305.desc: Lemon Cherry Sherbet is a hybrid cannabis strain, likely a cross between Lemon Cherry Gelato and Sunset Sherbet, known for its fruity flavor profile (cherry, lemon, and sherbet) and balanced high. It's described as offering a sweet and sugary taste with a hint of spice, and an aroma with citrus, cherry, and gassy diesel notes. The high is said to be both bright and soothing, with mental and physical effects.

306.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

307.desc: The PAR Putter Pack in "Garden State Green" is a golf-themed pre-roll option that packages four 0.5-gram joints (totaling 2 grams of flower) alongside a functional golf tee and a ball marker. Leaning into its namesake "Garden State Green" profile, the strain delivers an intensely potent, high-THC infused experience anchored by a 1.1% terpene profile. It is heavily driven by dominant terpenes like beta-caryophyllene, linalool, and limonene, which combine to produce a distinct sensory mix of bright, citrus-forward notes, herbal depth, and a touch of peppery spice. When smoked, it kicks off with an uplifting, euphoric cerebral buzz that melts away daily stress and sharpens focus, before smoothly tapering into a calm, body-soothing relaxation that leaves you physically unwound without dragging you down into heavy sedation.

308.desc: The Mafia Wives Z Marker 5-Pack Pre-Rolls by Brute's Roots offer a potent, well-balanced hybrid experience defined by a unique and pungent aromatic profile. True to its name, the strain leads with a sharp, chemical aroma reminiscent of permanent marker ink and sour gas, which beautifully contrasts with underlying notes of sweet tropical candy and artificial fruit. Upon consumption, users experience a smooth exhale of sweet candy and peppery floral spice that triggers a multi-stage effect. It begins with an uplifting, euphoric head buzz that sparks creative energy and boosts mood, before gently transitioning into a soothing body relaxation that melts away physical tension and stress without causing heavy couch-lock, making it ideal for afternoon or evening unwinding.

309.desc: Elyon's GG4 is a potent, sun-grown indica-dominant hybrid often sold as a 1.25g pre-roll, frequently crossed with OG Kush. Known for its high THC and pungent, earthy, and sour aroma, it delivers a heavy, euphoric, and relaxing "couch-lock" effect. Elyon uses sustainable practices and hand-trims its flower to preserve potency and flavor.

310.desc: McGlovin from Fresh comes as a seven-pack of half-gram hybrid pre-rolls. Customers describe the experience as giggly, creative and uplifted. The multi-pack makes it easy to share at a get-together or keep a few on hand for the weekend. On the lab report the leading terpenes are beta-caryophyllene (a peppery, warm-spice edge), linalool (a soft, floral lavender tone) and limonene (a bright, zesty citrus note). Together they shape the aroma you notice when you first open it and the flavor on the exhale. Beyond THC, testing also shows measurable CBG and CBGA, minor cannabinoids that round out the overall profile. Hybrids usually land between sativa and indica and are often described as balanced, happy and easygoing. As a hybrid it is easy to fit into most plans: game night with friends, cooking a big meal, or unwinding after work. Light the tip evenly while rotating, take slow draws, and let it rest between pulls so it burns clean and even. A multi-pack is easy to share or to spread across several sessions, and each joint stays fresh until you open it. As with any new product, start low and go slow and give each session time before deciding on more. For adults 21 and over. Please consume responsibly and never drive after using cannabis.

311.desc: Ruby Violet joins our Dealer's Choice line - premium indoor, whole flower buds curated and precision-rolled on our Hefestus machine for a flawless, even burn. A cross of Grape Nana and Gush Mintz bred by Purple City Genetics, this hybrid brings sweet, fruity flavor layered with diesel and earthy depth, delivering a relaxed, happy, and creative high with a smooth finish. Hand-selected and meticulously rolled, it's the preroll you reach for when you trust your dealer to pick the winner.

312.desc: Giraffe Puzzy is a vibrant hybrid that brings tropical fruit character together with a rich, bakery-inspired finish. Bursts of sweet citrus and candy-like fruit create an expressive opening, while subtle notes of earth and warm dough add depth beneath the sweetness. Its layered personality reflects the meeting of Z and Animal Cookies Bx2, delivering a profile that feels playful up front with a more grounded character underneath. Distinctive, flavorful, and full of contrast, Giraffe Puzzy brings a fresh identity to the hybrid lineup.

313.desc:
Built for ease and flavor, the Goodies 5-Pack Pre-Rolls are made with all flower and zero trim. No shake, no shortcuts, just quality cannabis rolled for a smooth, consistent burn every time.

Instead of chasing strain names, we designed these packs around how you actually want to feel. Each 5-pack is thoughtfully blended to deliver a clear, dependable effect, whether you’re looking to stay energized, find balance, or fully unwind. It’s cannabis that fits into your day without overthinking it.

314.desc:
Yuzu Sour from Ozone is a citrus-forward hybrid built from Orange Sherbert, OZ Kush, and Gastropop genetics, giving it a bright, candy-like sour lemon/orange profile with underlying gas and fruit.
The buds are chunky, neon to lime green with vivid orange hairs and a frosty white trichome coat, visually echoing its “sparkling citrus” flavor. Aroma combines sharp citrus peel, sweet lemon candy, and floral notes over light earthy funk, while the taste layers zesty lemon candy with hints of diesel and creamy, fruity undertones. Effects tend to hit quickly with a rush of energy, euphoria, and sociability, ideal for daytime or early evening when you want to be uplifted but not overwhelmed. A gentle body relaxation follows without heavy couchlock, making Yuzu Sour a good option for stress relief, low motivation, or mood dips while staying functional.

315.desc: Dogwalkers Infused Show Dog “STAY” Big Pre-Roll offers 1g of hybrid flower infused with best-in-show diamonds in a single format. Conveniently packaged in an on-the-go tube, each Big Show Dog is crafted with strain-specific premium flower and diamonds; never shake, stems or seeds. Dogwalkers donates a portion of proceeds from every product sold to deserving animal shelters across the country.

316.desc: Elyon Grape Gas is a fruitier, candy-like cannabis strain with a hint of musk. It's an hybrid indica-dominant cultivar that's said to have consistent aromas, effects, and consistency between batches.

317.desc: Pavé, also known as “Pave,” is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the potent Paris OG X The Menthol strains. Named after the classic diamond setting, this bud has a beautiful appearance and delicious aroma that will have you drooling instantly. Like its namesake diamond setting, Pavé has a beautifully sparkling appearance, with dense diamond-shaped forest green nugs with deep purple undertones, lots of thin red-orange hairs and a coating of frosty, chunky bright white crystal trichomes. As you pull apart each dazzling little nugget, aromas of spicy peppery menthol and sweet sugary grapes are released, intensifying in potency the more that you toke. The flavor is of sweet fruity plums, fresh grapes and a punch of spicy menthol. The Pavé high will hit you pretty quickly after you exhale, taking on your brain before taking hold of your body. You'll find your mental state filled with a tingly euphoria that puts a smile on your face and a pep in your step. This tingle will soon turn buzzy and work its way throughout your entire body, eventually leaving you physically stoned and hopelessly couch-locked. With these effects and its high 27-29% average THC level, Pavé is often chosen to treat conditions such as depression or mood swings, chronic pain, nausea or appetite loss and chronic stress.

318.desc:
Gorilla Chem OG buds are typically dense and chunky, with a classic indica structure. The flowers are often coated in a thick layer of sticky resin and trichomes, giving them a frosty appearance. The coloration ranges from deep green to purple, with orange pistils scattered throughout.

This strain boasts a strong and complex aroma. It combines the pungent, fuel-like scent of Chemdawg with the earthy, piney undertones of Gorilla Glue #4. The overall fragrance is often robust, with hints of skunk and citrus adding depth to the profile.

When consumed, Gorilla Chem OG offers a flavorful experience that matches its aroma. The taste is typically a blend of diesel-like fuel, earthy pine, and hints of citrus or lemon zest. The smoke can be smooth, with a lingering aftertaste that may have spicy or herbal notes.

Gorilla Chem OG is known for its potent effects that tend to lean towards the indica side. It often induces a powerful, relaxing body high that can lead to deep sedation and couch-lock. Despite its indica dominance, it may also provide a cerebral uplift that can enhance mood and creativity before settling into a tranquil state of relaxation.

319.desc:
Genetics: Pure Kush x Wedding Crasher 
-- 
PK Crasher is an indica dominant strain that leaves a heavy, sedated effect on the user. Best used for nighttime consumption; PK Crasher can aid with insomnia, depression, and anxiety.

320.desc: True to its name, Game Over comes through with heavy-hitting flavor and presence. This strain brings forward deep, gassy notes layered with earthy spice and a touch of sweet funk, creating a rich and unforgettable profile. Potent and full-bodied, it’s a knockout choice for those who like their smoke strong and flavorful.

321.desc:
**THCA Diamond Infused**

Lemon Cherry Gelato is a extremely popular hybrid weed strain with several alleged origins. It could just be Gelato bagseed, aka a between Sunset Sherbet and Girl Scout Cookies. It can also be a type of Runtz, which is Gelato x Z. Now it is so popular, samples labeled 'LCG' surely include a broad range of Gelato, and Runtz varieties. Leafly customers tell us Lemon Cherry Gelato effects include tingly, relaxed, and euphoric. Medical marijuana patients often choose Lemon Cherry Gelato when dealing with symptoms associated with anxiety, pain, and stress. Bred by Backpackboyz, Lemon Cherry Gelato features an aroma of lime, berries, and citrus with flavors of lemon, and sweet fruit. The dominant terpene of this strain is caryophyllene.

322.desc:
Gyat delivers a tropical fusion of sweet pineapple and rich blueberry, complemented by earthy undertones. This strain offers a vibrant and fruity aroma, making each inhale a delightful experience. Users can expect a balanced high that promotes creativity and energy, coupled with a happy and uplifting mood. Gyat is designed to enhance daytime activities, making it ideal for social gatherings or creative endeavors.

FullTilt Labs is a small batch cannabis cultivation and manufacturing company in Ewing NJ. We believe in the power of cannabis to elevate
your experiences and broaden your horizons. Explore our diverse selection of flower and discover what it means to truly expand your mind!

323.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

324.desc: Yet another gem from Full Tilt. This reversal of Blueberry Bang Bang, Exotic Genetics award winning cross of cherry Bang Bang and Blueberry strains, has a rich and fruity aroma that gives off hints of ripened bananas, cherries and blueberries with a gassy, earthy undertone. By the time you get to the white ash on this stunner you will know why this is one of our favorite new strains for an afternoon sesh on the patio.

325.desc:
?? The Perfect Balance of Power & Flavor. ??

Sweet. Uplifting. Legendary. The White Widow x Strawberry Cough Infused Pre-Roll delivers a flawless fusion of iconic potency and juicy berry flavor. Expertly crafted with whole-infused flower, this slow-burning pre-roll is designed for those who want a smooth, flavorful smoke with both creative energy and full-body relaxation.

What Makes This Pre-Roll Different?

? Balanced Hybrid Brilliance – The legendary White Widow provides calming euphoria, while Strawberry Cough sparks focus, creativity, and a lifted mood.

? Strain-Specific Live Rosin Terpenes – Preserving the natural profile of both strains, bursting with sweet strawberry, earthy pine, and a hint of spice.

? Whole-Infused Flower – No trim, no shortcuts. We infuse the full buds for a consistent, powerful, and smooth burn.

? Kief-Coated Perfection – Extra potency, fuller flavor, and thicker, richer clouds in every pull.

? XL Burn – Crafted for social sessions or stretched across multiple smoke breaks.

?? Expect flavor-packed clouds, a smooth, even burn, and a high that balances mind and body — energizing yet grounding, euphoric yet chill. Whether you’re sparking creativity, enhancing social vibes, or just enjoying a deliciously smooth smoke, the White Widow x Strawberry Cough Pre-Roll is built to elevate every moment.

326.desc: High Wired Infused Cannabis products are hand-crafted for experienced enthusiasts, combining premium ground flower with high-quality concentrates and THCA diamond dust for a potent, smooth, and intense experience. Whether rolling a joint, packing a bowl, or enjoying a pre-roll, these products offer consistency, potency, and rich flavor in every puff. High Wired is a knockout experience. Every. Single. Time.

327.desc: Get ready to elevate your smoke session with LOOSIES AK47 INFUSED 1G preroll. This hybrid powerhouse combines premium flower with potent cannabis concentrates, delivering an amplified experience that hits harder and lasts longer than your average preroll. AK47 is celebrated for its balanced effects that inspire creativity and euphoria while keeping you relaxed and social—perfect for both daytime adventures and evening unwind. Expect a complex flavor profile blending earthy, spicy notes with hints of sweet florals and pungent fuel undertones. The infusion process enhances potency without compromising the strain's signature characteristics, making each puff smooth, flavorful, and satisfyingly strong.

328.desc: Strawberry Cannoli is a slightly sativa leaning strain named for its delicious flavor and gorgeous appearance. Strawberry Cannoli has a sweet, citrus, fruity strawberry flavor with a rich creamy exhale that is slightly spicy at times. The aroma is just as amazing, with a sweet strawberry overtone that's accented by hints of fresh citrus, earth and spices. The Strawberries Cannoli high settles in the brain first before spreading throughout your physical form. You'll feel a lifted sense that launches your mind into a cerebral state of energy and happiness, pushing out any negative or racing thoughts immediately. As your mind reaches new heights of creativity and euphoria, your body will settle into a relaxing state that has you physically calmed without causing any sedation.

329.desc:
Original Glue x Alien Breath

Deep Breath is an evenly balanced hybrid strain named for its celebrity heritage and soothing effects. Deep Breath is a great choice for any indica lover who's after a fast-hitting high that will get them relaxed in no time flat. The high starts almost as soon as you exhale, launching through the mind with an energizing effect. You'll be filled with sociability and happiness accompanied by a boost in creativity that gets your artistic juices flowing. A relaxing body high accompanies this happy boost, keeping you anchored without dampening your energy level in the slightest.

330.desc: Blueberry Diesel is a cross of two favorite strains, Blueberry and Sour Diesel. It is probably best known for its strong blueberry smell with hints of fuel from its Diesel lineage. Blueberry flavors overwhelm its sticky flowers, which should have plenty of trichomes and long orange hairs. Effects tend to be happy and relaxing but not too overwhelming, making this a popular choice for many kinds of consumers.

332.desc:
Ride the build-up with Crescendo from Pete’s Farmstand, a 1g pre-roll that starts smooth and steadily climbs into a powerful, feel-good high. This hybrid brings a layered flavor profile of sweet citrus, woody spice, and a hint of berry on the exhale, giving each hit a complex, satisfying finish.

As the name suggests, the effects come on gradually, lifting your mood, easing stress, and wrapping the body in a calm, relaxing buzz without knocking you out right away. It’s a great pick for evening sessions when you want to unwind, get a little spacey, and let the tension of the day fade away.

Format: 1g pre-roll
Flavor/Aroma: Citrus, sweet woods, berry, light fuel

Effects: Uplifted, euphoric, relaxing, stress-relieving

Best For: After-work sessions, chilling at home, easing body tension

333.desc: Lineage: Spritzer x Hellcat #15 Sour pez and grape sweet tarts fill the air with this variety. This Grown Rogue exclusive is hits deep, offers rich flavor, and an effect that delivers over and over.

334.desc: Military Chocolate is a potent, balanced 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain bred by Oni Seed Co (Bubba Kush x Tropicanna Cookies). It is known for its rich, dessert-like aroma of chocolate, coffee, and creamy vanilla. The high offers a fast-acting, euphoric, and creative buzz, accompanied by, relaxing body effects suitable for treating stress.

335.desc:
**Diamond Infused**

Magic Marker is a hybrid strain made from a genetic cross of Permanent Marker x RS-11 This strain is a stinker, with a pungent mix of astringent, minty chemical notes laced with sherbet sweetness and a tropical fruity twist—like sniffing your favorite marker during art class. Both of Magic Marker’s parent strains have won cup titles

336.desc: Lemon Runtz from Victory Natural Farms is a hybrid cannabis strain celebrated for its sweet, citrusy flavor with bright lemon zest and a subtle, savory finish. Grown organically in living soil, it delivers a balanced, euphoric yet relaxing high, making it perfect for a variety of occasions. Fans love how it combines the classic smoothness of Runtz genetics with juicy, uplifting citrus notes.

337.desc: The Cookies and Cream flavor is very much like the name suggests, with tastes of sweet vanilla and nutty earth topped with creamy butter. The aroma is just as delicious, with an overtone of sweet nutty earth and a touch of vanilla as the nugs are burned. The Cookies and Cream high has sweet long-lasting effects that are perfect for any hybrid lover. The high starts with a happy head lift that's both euphoric and creative with a slight sense of energy. This is accompanied by a relaxing sleepy effect that leaves you dazed and blissfully unaware of any pain or anything happening around you.

338.desc:
Yoshi from Pete’s Farmstand is best thought of as a bright, modern hybrid with a playful profile. Based on how Pete’s Farmstand menus and related strain descriptions are typically presented, it likely leans toward sweet, fruity, and candy-like notes rather than the heavy gas of a classic OG, with a flavor that feels more lively than earthy.

The experience is usually described as balanced at first, with a quick cerebral lift that can make things feel more upbeat, chatty, and visually sharp before easing into a gentler body calm. That makes it a strain many people associate with afternoon or early evening use, especially when they want something enjoyable without immediately getting knocked out.

If you like strains that feel modern, flavorful, and easy to enjoy, Yoshi fits that lane well. It sounds like one of Pete’s Farmstand’s more approachable options: less pine-and-diesel, more sweet smoke, smooth vibes, and a steady hybrid finish.

339.desc:
Gorilla Butter X Strawberries n' Cream

Strawilla is a balanced hybrid that delights the senses with a juicy fusion of ripe strawberries and creamy vanilla, creating a rich and inviting aroma. Its vibrant, resin-coated buds reflect the strain's full-flavored character and premium quality.

The effects provide a smooth blend of uplifting cerebral stimulation and soothing body relaxation, making Strawilla an ideal choice for those seeking both mental clarity and calm focus throughout the day or evening. This harmony of effects supports creativity, mood enhancement, and a gentle unwinding without heaviness.

340.desc:
DogWalkers | 95 Cookies | Indica | 1g

[orig: Chem Dawg I-95 x Girl Scout Cookies] is a potent, heavy-hitting indica strain with an equally powerful, especially pungent nose of sour gas.

Dogwalkers Infused Show Dog “STAY” Big Pre-Roll offers 1g of hybrid flower infused with best-in-show THCa diamonds in a single format. Conveniently packaged in an on-the-go tube, each Big Show Dog is crafted with strain-specific premium flower and THCa diamonds; never shake, stems or seeds. Dogwalkers donates a portion of proceeds from every product sold to deserving animal shelters across the country.

341.desc:
Flavor Note: A distinct blend of sweet, deep fruit undertones layered with a sharp, savory, or slightly sour profile.

Effects: Best suited for experienced consumers looking for a potent punch. It delivers a strong, full-body physical relaxation coupled with a heavy, calming mental state that is excellent for evening use or easing into a peaceful sleep.

342.desc:
The flavor is a standout highlight: sweet cinnamon sugar cookie with nutty undertones, accented by peppery kush and spicy black pepper on the exhale. The aroma mirrors the taste, blending flowery kush, nutty cookies, and a sharp black pepper overtone that lingers pleasantly.

Effects settle in slowly, starting with a gentle calm that wraps around both mind and body, then building into a happy, carefree mental state paired with deep physical relaxation. You’ll feel lifted and creative while also settling into the couch, ready to relax without full sedation.

343.desc:
Rosin Tech Labs’ Strawberry Punch Hash Joint is a premium 1g infused pre-roll crafted with 0.8g of Banana Punch flower and 0.2g of Strawberry Fumez ice water hash for a smooth, terpene-rich smoking experience. This 80/20 blend combines quality flower with pure solventless ice water hash to deliver enhanced flavor and potency in every draw.

Expect bright strawberry sweetness layered with creamy, dessert-like notes and subtle earthy undertones for a rich, flavorful finish. The balanced infusion provides an uplifting cerebral buzz followed by comfortable body relaxation, making it a versatile choice for any session.

344.desc: Gruntz is for the connoisseur. While it may open with a clear-headed lift - it quickly settles into a deep, heavy body sedation that melts away tension and invites full couch-lock. Perfect for late-night unwinding or solo relaxation, it balances its uplifting cerebral spark with a grounding, sedative finish that lingers long after the last exhale.

345.desc: Candy Fumes is a hybrid created from the indica-forward Zkittlez and the high-potency Sherbanger. Candy Fumes packs the same sweet and flavorful palette as Zkittlez while incorporating the benefits of Sherbanger's superior genetics. That means a strong terpene profile and THC levels that typically exceed both of its parent strains, winning fans as much for its craveable flavor profile as for its warm body high. Fruity and sweet on the nose, fans of Candy Fumes report a giddy front end and gentle comedown for easy relaxation and pain relief.

346.desc: Military Chocolate is a potent, balanced 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain bred by Oni Seed Co (Bubba Kush x Tropicanna Cookies). It is known for its rich, dessert-like aroma of chocolate, coffee, and creamy vanilla. The high offers a fast-acting, euphoric, and creative buzz, accompanied by, relaxing body effects suitable for treating stress.

350.desc: Cheetah’s Galaxy Glue 5-Pack brings a bold, gassy aroma with sweet, earthy undertones. Each piece has a clean, colorful appearance, while the flavor blends funky fuel, sweet earth, and subtle hints of tropical fruit for a smooth, memorable finish.

351.desc: Frogurt (often stylized as Froyo) by The Cut is a hybrid cannabis strain known for its balanced effects and dessert-like flavor profile. It is a rare, exotic hybrid favored for its sweet and tangy taste, which is reminiscent of creamy frozen yogurt.

352.desc:
The strain functions as an aromatic collision between two of cannabis' most influential flavor families:

Mother Strain: Chemdawg #4 (or Chem4), which contributes heavy, fuel-soaked aromatics, chemical bite, and high potency.

Father Strain: Strawberry Sour Diesel (or a similar sweet berry variant depending on the breeder), which lends color, smoothness, and candy-like sweetness.

353.desc:
Mellowz inherits a unique "dessert-meets-fuel" profile:

Taste: Sweet, creamy marshmallow entry, quickly followed by grape candy and a citrus-sherbet zest on the exhale.

Aroma: A bright, sour lemon-citrus overtone layered over rich, burned-sugar sweetness and a faint diesel/jet-fuel depth.

354.desc: This iconic combination creates a super tasty child strain with soothing, nighttime effects that are perfect for getting you ready to get to sleep when you just can't seem to get there on your own. The flavor of Maple Root is a great nod to both of its parent strains, with a creamy and sugary root beer like taste accented by hints of fruity candies and a surprising punch of garlicky herbs. The aroma takes things up about five levels, adding in layers of pungent dank, skunky sage and woody pine to the fruity and sugary blend. The Maple Root high will begin immediately, starting with a tingle felt in the extremities that is numbing and pleasant. This tingle will soon begin to ebb and flow throughout the rest of your body, hitting your body with deep relaxation and your mind with a sense of hazy, happy sedation that leaves you feeling super elated yet unable to focus.

355.desc: FullTilt Labs Zabubu is a premium hybrid cannabis strain crafted from a potent cross of Zkittlez and Super Boof. This lineage explains the strain's complex combination of sugary, tropical fruit undertones and sharp citrus punch.

356.desc: 95 Cookies is a potent, indica-leaning hybrid that blends GSC’s dessert-like sweetness with Chemdawg I-95’s bold diesel punch. Rich, nutty earthiness meets sour gas for a uniquely complex profile. Heavy-hitting and deeply relaxing, this strain delivers a powerful experience wrapped in layered flavor. Explore your taste in premium cannabis with RYTHM's curated lineup of expertly cultivated, award-winning strains. Strain type: Hybrid Lineage: Chemdawg i95 x GSC Dominant flavors: Sweet, earthy, nutty.

357.desc: Rolled up and ready to smoke, Pre-Rolls are a convenient and effective way to consume cannabis. Pre-Rolls come in many different forms and can be rolled with flower, shake, "b-buds", infused with concentrates, and more.

358.desc: Jerzy Landscapes presents TK Headband, a premium hybrid preroll delivering a balanced cannabis experience in a convenient 1g format. This expertly crafted preroll showcases the legendary Headband genetics, known for creating a distinctive pressure around the crown while melting away tension throughout the body. The hybrid classification offers the best of both worlds—uplifting cerebral effects paired with soothing physical relaxation. Expect earthy, piney aromas with subtle diesel undertones that translate into a smooth, flavorful smoke. Perfect for those seeking creative focus during the day or unwinding after work, TK Headband promotes feelings of euphoria and calm without overwhelming sedation. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or exploring quality flower prerolls, this 1g offering from Jerzy Landscapes delivers consistent potency and craftsmanship in every puff.

359.desc: Flash Point OG is a hybrid cannabis strain with a high THC content, known for its relaxing, euphoric, and calming effects. It is noted for its distinctive citrus, spicy, and floral aroma. The specific genetics for this strain are not widely publicized, but its lineage is different from that of other OG strains.

360.desc: Garlic & Bananas, a distinctive hybrid strain, is the result of crossing GMO and Banana Punch. Its effects encompass a calming sense of euphoria that may spark creativity. The strain’s unique aroma profile includes notes of sweet bananas and a touch of gas, creating an uplifting experience. With its combination of genetics, Garlic & Bananas offers a fusion of effects and aromas that may intrigue and uplift your senses.

361.desc:
Pink Ink is a hybrid from First Class Genetics that brings Permanent Marker and Spritzer genetics together. This strain delivers a colorful flavor experience—"pink" hard candy sweetness that blends with tangy Smarties notes, backed by gassy undertones and finished with floral perfume characteristics.

Effects might offer that creative balance between mental uplift and physical comfort. A lot of people appreciate how this one can work for social sessions or when they want something with personality, though everyone's ride is unique. The Permanent Marker genetics contribute that bold intensity, while Spritzer adds its own bubbly complexity to the mix.

This hybrid connects with those who dig vibrant flavors and versatile vibes. It's got that pop of color with some artistic edge—a strain that brings something bright and memorable for those looking to add some flair to their rotation.

362.desc: The 1:1 THC:CBD Restore Lotion is a balanced topical product that combines equal parts of THC and CBD to potentially soothe and revitalize the skin. This lotion aims to address skin concerns using the synergistic effects of THC's mild psychoactivity and CBD's calming properties. It contains natural ingredients for hydration and is meant for targeted application.

363.desc: Say hello to convenience with our high-CBD Escape Artists Relief Cream, now available in a gym bag-friendly tube! We’ve combined the restorative benefits of camphor and menthol with 1000mg total cannabinoids, making it perfect for your post-workout routine. This blend provides quick, targeted results where you need it most with 800mg CBD, 100mg CBG, and 100mg THC. This enhanced formula supports anyone from seasoned athletes to weekend warriors seeking relief that will leave your skin soft and revitalized.

364.desc: Doctor Solomon’s Rescue Lotion is a medical-grade, cannabis-infused transdermal topical designed to provide emergency, fast-acting relief for deep tissue inflammation, chronic flare-ups, and localized pain. Unlike standard over-the-counter topicals that only coat the surface, this formula utilizes a proprietary transdermal carrier that penetrates beneath the skin barrier to deliver cannabinoids directly to affected blood vessels and muscle tissues.

365.desc:

Blue Z blends the dessert-like sweetness of The Original Z lineage with the rich depth of Blue Diamond, creating an indica-leaning cured resin vape with layered flavor and unmistakable terpene presence. Bright bursts of tart citrus and candied fruit open the profile before settling into creamy earth, soft wildflower notes, and smooth herbal spice on the finish. Dominant myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene give the vapor a dense aromatic character with sweet citrus lift, subtle floral complexity, and lingering candy-like smoothness throughout each pull.

Powered by a quartz atomizer for clean, terp-true vapor, this 0.5g all-in-one device offers concentrate-level potency in a sleek, ready-to-use format — crisp, cooling, and out-of-this-world smooth. Crafted from cured Megaleaf flower using cannabis-derived extraction, the formulation preserves the cultivar’s full-spectrum expression with 100% cannabis and nothing added.

Built around quality flower, careful extraction, and terpene-preserving formulation, Eclipse X Megaleaf Blue Z delivers a refined cured resin vape experience focused on flavor depth, cultivar authenticity, and dependable craftsmanship.
