The pungent sweet cherry scent may create a feeling of peace and contentment, like watching a sunset after a long day. Don't be surprised if the euphoric, cerebral high brings on a case of the giggles.

371.desc: Raspberry Crush is a deliciously sweet and tangy strain, now available in a 1g vape cartridge for a smooth, flavorful experience. This cartridge captures the essence of ripe raspberries, with a burst of berry sweetness balanced by subtle citrus and earthy undertones. The high-quality extract provides a rich, refreshing flavor profile with every puff. Perfect for those who love fruity, dessert-like vapes, Raspberry Crush delivers a satisfying and flavorful session that’s both uplifting and enjoyable, making it ideal for on-the-go moments.

As you partake in Dr. Funkenstein, the flavor profile reflects its genetic heritage, providing a delightful combination of

378.desc:
Lemon Drop invites you to savor the essence of a sun-soaked summer with every inhale. This premium cannabis-infused distillate vape cartridge captures the perfect balance of sour and sweet, reminiscent of a freshly picked ripe lemon. The invigorating aroma of sharp, juicy citrus mingles with delightful candy undertones, creating a tantalizing scent that awakens the senses and sets the stage for a memorable experience.

The flavor profile of Lemon Drop is a vibrant celebration of citrusy brilliance. Each puff delivers a burst of zesty lemon paired with the sugary sweetness of your favorite candies, creating a mouth-puckering sensation that is both refreshing and indulgent. Enhanced by its terpene trio—Limonene, Pinene, and Terpinene—this vape cartridge offers layers of complexity. 418.desc:
The Strain - Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects. Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers.

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

419.desc:
Fatso x Cotton Candy — some Atlas Seed listings cite Pilot Light x Cotton Candy

Balanced Hybrid

Atlas Seed

Turtle Taffy is a modern autoflower standout from California breeder Atlas Seed, and it plays against type. Where most "taffy" and "candy" strains chase pure sweetness, Turtle Taffy pairs sugary confection with a loud, gassy funk—the result of its Fatso parent, a heavy GMO x Legend OG cut from the OG/Chem/Kush family known for savory, garlic-fuel depth. Crossed with Atlas's Cotton Candy auto donor, the sweetness gets pulled forward into a caramel-taffy candy note that rides on top of that funk. (Worth noting: some Atlas listings describe the cross as Pilot Light x Cotton Candy, so lineage accounts vary depending on the drop.) The bud finishes frosty and dense, with a terpene profile built on humulene, terpinolene, and linalool that gives it a sweet-and-funky nose backed by earthy spice. Because of the Fatso side, it's also a favorite for hash—dry sift or ice water. The high leans uplifting and energizing out the gate, sparking creativity and a fun, social mood before easing into a mild, comfortable fade. A great pick for a daytime creative session, an active hang, or any time you want something sweet with an unexpected gassy twist.

For consumers looking to stretch their stash without losing quality, The Lid’s Carney’s Candy shake hits the sweet spot. It’s ideal for those who love sweet, dessert-forward cannabis and want more bang for their buck—without skimping on effects or flavor.

518.desc: Blues Qlues showcases dense, frosty buds with deep green and bluish-purple tones, all wrapped in a thick layer of sparkling trichomes. Its aroma leans sweet and fruity, with notes of ripe berries and a hint of creamy vanilla over a light earthy base. The flavor follows through with a smooth, dessert-like profile—juicy blueberry and mixed fruit on the inhale, finishing with a subtle creamy, slightly herbal exhale that lingers nicely.

519.desc: Pit Stop by Pete's Farmstand is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that is highly popular in New Jersey for its quality and affordability. Consumers usually report smooth, earthy, and relaxing effects, making it a great budget-friendly option for unwinding.

520.desc: Kind Tree's Sherbanimal (Animal Face × Sherb Crasher) is a popular potent indica-dominant hybrid. Known for dessert-forward gassy and sweet cookie-funk flavors it delivers a smooth uplifting cerebral high that transitions into deep calming body relaxation.

521.desc: Egg Roll is an indica dominant hybrid strain created through crossing the classic Chemdawg X Biscotti strains. Named for its interesting appearance, Egg Roll is a great indica for a late evening when you want to really kick back and enjoy yourself with friends. The flavor is on the sweeter side of things, with a fruity plum taste accented by hints of spicy black pepper.

522.desc:
Deep Orbit Indica Blend is a heavy, nighttime-leaning cannabis expression designed around deep relaxation and full-body unwinding. While “Deep Orbit” isn’t a widely standardized lineage like classic strains, it is typically presented in the Kind Tree lineup as an indica blend meant to deliver a layered, sedative experience built for end-of-day use.

The profile leans into rich, earthy and fuel-forward aromas with subtle sweet and herbal undertones. On first break-up of the flower, users often notice a mix of dank spice, dark earth, and faint fruity gas—an aroma style commonly associated with heavy indica hybrids and Kush-adjacent genetics. The flavor tends to mirror the nose, starting smooth and slightly sweet on inhale, then finishing with a deeper, more pungent, earthy exhale.

Effects are where Deep Orbit defines itself. It generally begins with a gentle cerebral calm that quickly transitions into a weighted body sensation. Tension in the shoulders, neck, and back tends to melt away, followed by a slow-down in mental activity and a strong sense of physical ease. At higher doses, it can become strongly sedating, making it well-suited for evening relaxation, stress relief, or preparing for sleep.

Overall, Kind Tree’s Deep Orbit Indica Blend is built as a “shut-the-world-down” style strain—less about mental stimulation and more about gravity, calm, and deep physical recovery after a long day.

523.desc: Garden Greens Peanut Butter Cup 3.5g is a premium, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower. It features rich, nutty, and kushy flavors with dominant terpenes like Limonene and Beta-Caryophyllene. It is known for delivering a deep, relaxing, and mood-enhancing experience.

524.desc:
Sherbanimal by Kind Tree is a potent indica-dominant hybrid known for dessert-like sweetness, gassy funk, and a creamy sherbet finish. It’s commonly described as a cross of Animal Face and Sherb Crasher, and some listings also emphasize its relaxing, evening-friendly character.

The aroma tends to be rich and layered, with sweet fruity notes, sugary candy tones, subtle earthiness, and a slightly gas-forward exhale. Users often report a calming body effect with a mellow, content headspace, making it a good fit for unwinding after a long day or easing into sleep. Flavor-wise, it leans toward sweet cherry, creamy sherbet, lemon, and cookie-funk accents depending on the batch.

525.desc: A decadent cross of Animal Cake x Sprinklez, Vanilla Sprinklez delivers a sweet, creamy vanilla aroma with hints of sugar and dough. Its dessert-like flavor and smooth finish make it a treat for the senses — rich, indulgent, and impossible to forget.

526.desc: Taffy Twist by RYTHM is a flavorful indica-dominant strain crossed from Lomelo 18 and Sour Animal Cherries. It features a candy-like sweet and sour citrus profile with a sugary finish. Users typically experience a gentle mental uplift that transitions into relaxing, calming body effects perfect for evening unwinding

527.desc: Taffy Twist by RYTHM is a flavorful indica-dominant strain crossed from Lomelo 18 and Sour Animal Cherries. It features a candy-like sweet and sour citrus profile with a sugary finish. 528.desc: A collab between Bloom Seed Co. and Boston Root Seed, Super Gremlin was created by crossing 09’ Animal Cookies x Sherbanger. With aromas of pungent earth, sweet herbs, and a sour overtone, Super Gremlin will be sure to leave you relaxed. Super Gremlin buds are deep green with dark purple tones and bright orange hairs, making this strain equally beautiful as it is enjoyable.

529.desc:
Hash Burger from My Dad’s Stash is a potent, savory indica-leaning hybrid known for its loud funk, heavy resin, and deeply relaxing finish. It typically delivers a bold aroma that blends hash, gas, earth, and peppery spice, with flavor notes that can lean toward garlic, onion, pine, and a slightly sweet, spicy exhale.

This strain is often chosen by consumers looking to wind down after a long day. Its effects are commonly described as uplifting at first, then gradually settling into a calm, body-heavy sensation that may help ease stress, tension, and a racing mind. Because of its strength, Hash Burger is usually better suited for evening use or moments when you do not need to stay highly active.

Visually, Hash Burger often features dense, frosty buds with a sticky, trichome-rich coating that reflects its hash-forward name. For brands like My Dad’s Stash, it fits well as a premium, terpene-rich cultivar with a bold personality and a memorable, old-school-meets-modern flavor profile.

530.desc:
Aroma Profile

The strain features a loud, complex fragrance that fills a room quickly after grinding.

Primary Notes: A bright hit of sweet candied lemon peel mixed with tart, juicy maraschino cherries.

Undertones: A smooth, creamy vanilla soft-serve and sugar cookie finish.

Accents: Subtle traces of spicy black pepper, earthy pine, and a faint gassy twang on the backend.

Experiential Effects

This hybrid typically delivers a full-bodied effects that feel uplifted yet deeply relaxed.

Mental Onset: It hits quickly with a soaring wave of euphoria, clear-headed mental clarity, and creative energy.

Mood Shift: Expect a chatty, outgoing social window and a carefree attitude where stress melts away.

Physical Plateau: As the high settles, a warm body calm spreads to ease physical aches and muscle tension.

The Taper: It keeps you tranquil and content without immediate heavy couchlock,

Bluephoria features a sweet, modern, dessert-inspired aroma profile:

Undertones: The fruitiness is layered with hints of citrus zest and a smooth, creamy earthiness.

The Inhale/Exhale: Consumers note a highly flavorful, smooth smoke that tastes like sweet berry syrup with a subtle herbal finish.

533.desc:
Dulce de Uva from Good Green is an indica-leaning hybrid bred from Grape Pie and OG Kush, widely praised for its intensely sweet, grape-candy profile and mellow, mood-lifting effects. The strain delivers a smooth, full-body relaxation paired with a gentle cerebral uplift that leaves many users feeling happy, relaxed, and slightly giggly, making it suitable for evening wind-down sessions or late-afternoon stress relief. Medical consumers often reach for Dulce de Uva to ease anxiety, depression, chronic stress, and low-to-moderate pain, since it calms the mind and softens the body without always forcing deep sedation at lower doses.

Flavor is the standout feature: bright, sugary grape candy with a creamy vanilla undercurrent and subtle earthy OG notes, evoking fresh grape juice or fruity taffy. The aroma is similarly sweet and fruity, with ripe grape and berry scents accented by soft vanilla and faint hints of skunky diesel that keep it from feeling one-dimensional. Good Green typically offers Dulce de Uva as mixed buds or popcorn, but the nugs remain dense and frosty, with classic green-and-purple hues and a generous trichome blanket that hints at a rich, dessert-focused experience. Overall, this strain is ideal for fans of grape-forward, candy-like terps who want a calming yet cognitively gentle high.

Description

Gas Nana is a indica cultivar known for its bold fuel-forward aroma, dense structure, and heavy resin production. The flowers are typically tight and chunky, featuring deep green buds with occasional purple undertones, bright orange pistils, and a thick coating of frosty, sticky trichomes that reflect its rich terpene content.

Aroma & Flavor
Gas Nana is commonly described as offering a powerful blend of pungent diesel and earthy gas layered with sweet banana and ripe fruit. Subtle notes of creamy sweetness and light herbal spice add depth, creating a profile that balances tropical dessert tones with sharp fuel intensity. The flavor follows through with a smooth combination of sweet banana, creamy fruit, and a lingering gassy, earthy finish on the exhale.

Experience
Consumers often report a calm, mood-elevating onset followed by a steady wave of full-body relaxation. The effects are typically described as soothing and body-forward, supporting mental ease and physical comfort while maintaining a relaxed, functional state. Individual experiences may vary.

Typical Characteristics
Type: Indica

Reported Experience: Relaxed, uplifted, balanced calm

Strain Details

Grower: Blueprint Cannabis Co.

Type: Indica-dominant hybrid

Aroma & Taste: Umami, dark berries, floral sherbet, and gassy citrus

Top Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, Linalool

537.desc:
Blueprint P90 (3.5g) is a premium, indica-dominant cannabis flower heavily nicknamed the "Gas Man" due to its remarkably pungent, room-filling aroma. It is highly regarded for its top-tier indoor cultivation quality, resinous and sticky buds, and deeply sedative, heavy-hitting effects.

Strain Overview & Lineage

Lineage: P90 is a powerhouse cross between Gorilla Glue #4 (GG4) x Gelato 41, bringing together elite genetics that offer deep chemical, earthy, and sweet dessert qualities.

Appearance: Dense, hard, medium-sized light green buds layered with vibrant hues of violet and blue, completely coated in a heavy white layer of shimmering, resinous trichomes.

Aroma, Flavor, and Terpene Profile

The strain is famous for a "nose-burning funk" that combines traditional gassy undertones with unique flavor complexities:

Scent: A powerful infusion of skunk, diesel fuel, hazelnut, and chemicals, with a subtle menthol finish.

Taste: A clean, heavy inhale of gassy, creamy earthiness balanced by faint, sweet floral undertones on the exhale.

Dominant Terpenes: Testing reveals a profile heavily dominated by Beta-Caryophyllene, followed by Limonene, Linalool, and Humulene .

Experience & Effects

The High: Expect an immediate full-body melt that dissolves physical tension, creates "heavy eyes," and brings on a deeply tranquil state of mind.

Best Used For: Unwinding after a long day, managing physical aches, easing severe insomnia, or any evening routine dedicated to deep relaxation.

538.desc:
Triple Lindy is a award-winning premium hybrid cannabis strain bred by Blueprint Cannabis Co. that achieved major acclaim by winning Best Overall and Most Potent at the 2022 Winter Zalympix competition. Named after the famous impossible dive from the movie Back to School, this cultivar is highly regarded in the dessert-gas category for its heavy-hitting potency and dense, frosty bag appeal.

Genetic Lineage & Profile

While some early industry sources listed its family tree as a mystery, it is widely recognized as a modern hybrid cross between Z (Zkittlez) and Gelato 41 (G41).

Type: Indica-dominant leaning hybridStructure: Dense calyx stacking, tight internodal spacing, and a heavy coating of trichomes making it visually striking.

Cultivation: Notoriously difficult and sensitive to grow, but highly rewarding for experienced cultivators.

Flavor and Aroma Profile

The strain features a complex, layered "dessert-gas" profile that combines sweet and deeply savory elements:

Aroma: A pungent mix of rubber, musk, tropical fruit, and sweet candy gas.

Flavor: Creamy, doughy sweetness upfront, blending into heavy diesel, cheese, and a peppery-citrus finish.

Dominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool, Humulene, and Pinene.

Experienced Effects

Triple Lindy delivers a potent "one-two-three punch" that satisfies both physical and cerebral preferences:

Cerebral Lift: An immediate euphoric rush that boosts mood and relieves mental stress.

Body High: A deeply relaxing, heavy physical sedation that spreads across the limbs without immediate couchlock, making it ideal for evening use

Whether you're a seasoned stoner or a first-time toker, Gelato 41 will treat you to a flavorful adventure you won't soon forget. These dense, aromatic buds showcase Craft Kings’ signature indoor craftsmanship, offering smooth burns and robust terpene expression in every pack. Ice Cream Cake brings a deeply relaxing, feel-good vibe that melts the body into calm comfort while keeping the mind gently uplifted, making it a great choice for evening wind-downs, stress relief, and slow, cozy sessions.

553.desc:
Harvest Moon Farms Purple Elephant (3.5g) is an Indica flower strain known for its deeply relaxing effects and distinct fruit-forward profile. It is widely available across dispensaries in New Jersey.

The true pedigree of Purple Elephant carries a bit of West Coast mystery, but cannabis historians and breeders generally agree on its roots:

The Mother: Purple Urkle, a legendary cultivar originating from the Pacific Northwest (Mendocino/Humboldt County). This passes down the intense grape candy aromatics and heavy, relaxing traits.

The Father: The original cut is believed to be a cross between Purple Urkle and an undisclosed variety—frequently attributed as either a robust Gage Green selection or a mystery Sativa line that added structural heft and larger colas.

Aroma & Flavor
Nose: Breaking open a jar releases a pungent burst of sweet grape candy and musty, damp earth. It is backed by sharp dark berry edges and a woodsy, herbal spice.

Taste: The smoke is smooth and layered. It leads with a heavy sweetness reminiscent of ripe berries and artificial grape candy, finishing with a sharp, kushy earthiness and subtle chemical undertones on the exhale.

Effects & Therapeutic Uses:
While standard cuts of Purple Elephant can occasionally lean into daytime focus, the specific Harvest Moon Farms batch leans into a heavier evening profile:

The High: It hits quickly, initiating a calming euphoria that blankety wraps both mind and body. Users report feeling deeply serene, relaxed, and mildly hungry without immediate couch-lock, though high doses transition quickly into deep sleepiness.

Medical Benefits: According to Leafwell, the strain “is often used for its potential to relieve stress, anxiety, and depression. It may also help with pain management and insomnia due to its relaxing and sedating effects.

OG Kush phenotype (Lake Tahoe cut)

Indica-Leaning Hybrid

Ganja Guru (Lake Tahoe, CA)

Tahoe OG is one of the most respected OG cuts to ever come out of California. A standout phenotype of OG Kush, it was selected by the breeder Ganja Guru in the Lake Tahoe/Mammoth region, who hunted through OG Kush phenos to lock in one of the most potent, fast-hitting expressions of the line. It later got its widest release through Cali Connection, but the Tahoe cut itself is the star—a strain that's racked up over a thousand smoke reports and a reputation as one of the definitive nighttime OGs. The bud is classic Kush: dense, chunky, forest-green nugs with orange pistils and a heavy frost of trichomes. The nose is textbook OG—earthy, lemony, and pungent with that unmistakable fuel-and-pine kush funk. What sets Tahoe apart is the speed and weight of the effect: it comes on fast and heavy, melting into a lazy, full-body relaxation with just enough euphoric, sativa-like head lift to keep the mood bright before the couch calls. A go-to for a rainy day, a heavy wind-down, or anyone chasing a great night's sleep—this is the kind of OG you save for when you've got nowhere to be.

727.desc: The Strain: Dungeon Vault Genetics’ Grapezilla stomps onto the scene as a mighty indica born from Original Glue and Vino OG. Myrcene’s cozy musk weaves through that grape sweetness, while Pinene’s refreshing forest breeze cuts through the richness. Caryophyllene’s peppery spice and Limonene’s lemon-lime flair mingle on the exhale, leaving a complex aftertaste that invites another toke. Grapezilla’s effects mirror its terpene tapestry: a gradual wave of calm that encourages deep relaxation and puts the body at ease. Pinene’s clarity helps keep the mind gently engaged, so you can dive into a good book, sink into your favorite playlist, or simply relish a quiet moment. Caryophyllene’s warm embrace and Myrcene’s soothing weight make sinking into the couch all but inevitable, yet Limonene’s lift ensures you never lose complete alertness - truly the apex of chill. 839.desc:
We are excited to introduce THCV Rich Lemon Lime Soft Lozenges, the newest addition to our line of ratio-formulated products! The goal of our ratio-formulated line is to provide our patients with access to a line of diverse cannabinoid products that meet their specific relief and wellness needs with targeted, adjustable effects. Our THCV-Rich Soft Lozenges are unique in their formulation, because we source THCV from the in-house extraction of our own THCV-rich cultivars.

WHAT IS THCV?
Tetrahydrocannabivarin (THCV) is a lesser known cannabinoid that is starting to gain more attention for its potential appetite suppressant and energy stimulating effects. To date, THCV-forward products have not been widely available because THCV is typically found in low concentrations in many cultivars. As a result, cultivating for THCV isolate production can be costly for growers, and, consequently, the isolate may be prohibitively expensive for extract manufacturers seeking to formulate with THCV.

With this in mind, we undertook a search for cultivars that have higher concentrations of THCV. In the course of that search, we were able to find strains that, when grown at scale, allowed us to extract enough THCV for our ratio-formulated product line. 

BENEFITS
Because THCV has only recently gained attention, and because cannabis studies in general face a myriad of legal and financial obstacles, studies on THCV’s effects and symptom relief are limited. However, available research has found THCV to potentially reduce appetite, increase energy, and soothe anxiety. There is also some evidence that suggests it may curb some of THC’s intoxicating effects such as verbal recall issues, making it a potential option for patients seeking a product that allows them to be more functional during the day.

SYNERGISTIC EFFECTS:
This THCV-rich option is being offered in combination with THC because even in trace amounts, combinations of cannabinoids can produce a more effective response for patients' symptom relief. This is commonly referred to as the “Entourage Effect.”

Highly Co. Labs Pink Lemonade Soluble Rosin Powder is a fast-acting, water-soluble cannabis drink mix crafted via solventless ice-water extraction to preserve live rosin terpenes. Formulated with a balanced 1:1:1 ratio of THC, CBD, and CBG, the Sativa-Hybrid powder dissolves seamlessly into liquid for a quicker onset and a functional, relaxing experience.

Taste Profile

Pure Terpene Flavor: Because it contains zero added sugars, artificial dyes, or chemicals, the flavor relies primarily on the natural, full-spectrum live rosin.

Notes: Expect a bright, crisp blend of zesty lemon candy, tart grapefruit, and subtle sweet berry undertones from the Pink Lemonade strain profile. It finishes with a clean, slightly herbal, and earthy cannabis note.

Expected Effects

Fast Onset: Traditional edibles must pass through your liver, taking 1–2 hours to hit. This micro-encapsulated powder absorbs through your lymphatic system and sublingual pathways, kicking in within 5 to 15 minutes.

The "Social" Vibe: The balanced 1:1:1 THC, CBD, and CBG ratio generates an energetic, euphoric, and highly functional head high.

No Couch-Lock: The heavy body sedation typical of standard edibles is replaced by a bright, clear-headed buzz that keeps you talkative and relaxed. It is often described as an "inhalation-style" high without the smoke.

How to Consume It

The packaging includes a small measuring scoop (typically 10mg of cannabinoids per scoop) for precise dosing. You can consume it in three versatile ways:

Dissolve on Your Tongue: The fastest and most efficient delivery method. Simply place a scoop directly into your mouth and let it dissolve sublingually.

Mix Into Drinks: Because it is water-soluble, it blends smoothly without clumping. Stir a scoop into cold water, iced tea, or real lemonade to create an instant infused beverage.

Sprinkle on Food: You can lightly dust the powder over snacks or meals to effortlessly infuse your food
